name: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
label: Quest
description: Stealing Stormwind's Flame: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're practically glowing, traveler. What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: And this brightly-burning fire... You say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.
